rule: No change to the top/bottom-third rule or its flip while frozen. To change it: Love must say thaw first. Other rules can still be tuned.
scope: ONLY the top/bottom-third rule + its flip, on BTC and gold (Love, Oct 19 ~12:19 AM PT: "no i was talking specificallyyy about the new 33% rule, and how you instituted into bitcoin too"). Everything else stays adjustable.

frozenRule.what: Price actively FALLING from the top 33% of her channel (this 5m candle's high, open included, in the top third; price at least half the break distance under that high and not yet bounced the break distance off its low) = NO LONG -> FLIP to the SHORT if the short passes every other rule. Mirror: RISING from the bottom 33% = NO SHORT -> flip to the LONG.
frozenRule.where: bandlock.ts awayVerdict ("FALLING FROM THE TOP THIRD") + pivotbooks.ts ("THIRD-OF-CHANNEL FLIP")
